General Physician.description: Comprehensive primary care — routine check-ups, common illnesses, chronic disease management, and specialist referrals.

ENT.description: Diagnosis and treatment of hearing issues, sinus conditions, and throat infections with modern diagnostic tools.

Pediatrics.description: Health and development care for infants, children, and adolescents — vaccinations, growth monitoring, and childhood illnesses.

Gynecology.description: Women's health services covering prenatal care, maternity support, and gynecological treatment.

Cardiology.description: Diagnostics, treatment, and long-term management for heart conditions with advanced monitoring.

Dermatology.description: Skin, hair, and nail care — from acne and allergies to cosmetic and medical treatments.

Neurology.description: Diagnosis and treatment of disorders of the brain, spine, and nervous system.

Orthopaedics.description: Care for bones, joints, and muscles — fractures, joint pain, and mobility restoration.

Oncology.description: Comprehensive and compassionate cancer care across diagnosis, treatment, and recovery.

Gastroenterology.description: Diagnosis and treatment of digestive system disorders, from the stomach to the liver.

Nephrology.description: Specialised care for kidney conditions, including dialysis and long-term kidney health management.

Urology.description: Diagnosis and treatment of conditions affecting the urinary tract and male reproductive system.

Pulmonology.description: Care for lung and respiratory conditions, including asthma, COPD, and sleep-related breathing issues.

Endocrinology.description: Management of hormonal and metabolic conditions such as diabetes and thyroid disorders.

Rheumatology.description: Diagnosis and treatment of autoimmune and joint-related conditions like arthritis.

Ophthalmology.description: Complete eye care — vision correction, cataract treatment, and ongoing eye health checks.

Dentistry.description: General and cosmetic dental care, from routine cleanings to advanced restorative treatment.

Psychiatry.description: Mental health support and treatment for anxiety, depression, and other psychiatric conditions.

General Surgery.description: A broad range of surgical procedures handled by experienced general surgeons.

Plastic Surgery.description: Reconstructive and cosmetic surgical procedures tailored to individual needs.

Bariatric Surgery.description: Weight-loss surgical procedures and long-term support for sustainable results.

Emergency Medicine.description: Round-the-clock emergency care for urgent and critical medical situations.

Critical Care.description: Intensive monitoring and treatment for critically ill patients requiring close attention.

Radiology.description: Advanced diagnostic imaging services including X-ray, CT, MRI, and ultrasound.

Pathology.description: Laboratory diagnostics and testing to support accurate diagnosis and treatment planning.

Physiotherapy.description: Rehabilitation and physical therapy to restore movement and manage pain.

Nutrition & Dietetics.description: Personalised nutrition guidance and diet planning for better long-term health.

Geriatric Medicine.description: Specialised healthcare focused on the needs of elderly patients.

Infectious Diseases.description: Diagnosis and treatment of infections, from common illnesses to complex cases.

Hematology.description: Diagnosis and treatment of blood disorders, including anemia and clotting conditions.
